title: Tree Hover Flicker Fix
description: Fix tree hover flicker: stale row onPointerLeave clears highlight after fast hover enter on another row; sync TreeHighlightStore before paint.
summary: Fixed fast-hover flicker that made tree rows look selected: row onPointerLeave no longer clears semantic hover when relatedTarget is another tree row (stale leave after enter was resetting highlight); TreeHighlightStore now syncs in useLayoutEffect before paint. Test: shouldDispatchTreeRowPointerLeave. ui/react 98 tests pass.
